description: Shared dashboard patch cases. The TypeScript module (ui/src/features/insights/dashboard-patch.ts) and the Go port (internal/observabilitygateway/insights_patch.go) must both produce these results: the same document and placements, or the same error code and message. Go ignores expect.reason. Keep numbers within 2^53 and write integers without a fraction or exponent, since JavaScript cannot keep a number's literal.
